title: Quenched Peruvian Pato Arroz Con Pato
description: A rich, fermented post-workout dish originating from Peru, combining strong white bread flour with cured meats and vegetables.
instructions: In a large, heavy pot over medium-high heat, combine the diced cured pork and olive oil. Cook until the meat is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced onion, minced garlic, and diced red bell pepper to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the cooked rice, chicken broth, fermented rice vinegar, chicken bouillon, black pepper, and salt. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the crumbled queso fresco and continue to simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Using a fork, gently mash the cooked rice and meat mixture until it's well combined and slightly sticky.
Transfer the mixture to a large, shallow serving dish and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or until chilled.,
